# Opendian

Opendian styles a vault like developer documentation, with monospace-first typography, a layered radius system and minimal chrome that the description attributes to OpenCode. It uses terminal-grade code blocks, semantic callouts, an IDE-style sidebar and a single blue accent across light and dark modes on desktop and mobile.

![Opendian screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/elijahchan2019/obsidian-opendian-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Opendian"
    author: "elijahchan2019"
    repo:   "elijahchan2019/obsidian-opendian-theme"
    slug:   "opendian"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/opendian"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/elijahchan2019/obsidian-opendian-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/elijahchan2019/obsidian-opendian-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Style your vault like developer documentation with monospace-first typography, a layered radius system, and minimal chrome inspired by OpenCode. Use terminal-grade code blocks, semantic callouts, an IDE-style sidebar, and a single blue accent for a cohesive light and dark docs experience across desktop and mobile."
}
```
